The [[Sapphire of Ahdashim]] is a [[djinn]] in the [[Hidden City of Ahdashim]], in the Trial of Wisdom chamber. It appears only during the [[Dasha Vestibule]] [[mission]], and carries [[Sapphire Key|one of the keys]] to the [[Treasure of Ahdashim|treasure]] [[Margrid the Sly]] wants to collect for the mission's bonus objective.
